ci_support_linux_64_root_base6.36.8root_:
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '14'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma9
ldas_tools_framecpp:
- '2.9'
libboost_headers:
- '1.88'
root_base:
- 6.36.8
root_cxx_standard:
- '20'
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - root_base
  - root_cxx_standard
name: gds-root-extensions-base
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: gds-root-extensions
  version: 3.0.1
  gds_base_version: 3.0.1
  gds_lsmp_version: 3.0.1
  gds_frameio_version: 3.0.1

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://software.igwn.org/sources/source/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3f8abcddbf0ec88b124cafd5ffc941a6e5a010565f5c3e4ad63fafd57f926092
  patches:
    - fix-swap-noexcept.patch

build:
  number: 8
  skip:
    - win

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: gds-root-extensions-build
    build:
      script: build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - gnuconfig
        - make
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - gds-base >=${{ gds_base_version }}
        - gds-base-crtools >=${{ gds_base_version }}
        - gds-base-gdstrig >=${{ gds_base_version }}
        - gds-frameio-base >=${{ gds_frameio_version }}
        - gds-lsmp >=${{ gds_lsmp_version }}
        - ldas-tools-al
        - ldas-tools-framecpp
        - root_base
        - root_cxx_standard
        # to read framecpp headers:
        - libboost-headers

  - package:
      name: gds-root-extensions-base
    inherit: gds-root-extensions-build
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        include:
          - include/gds/**/*.hh
          - lib/lib*
          - lib/pkgconfig/gds*.pc
          - shared/gds/setup/root-setup
        exclude:
          # See gds-root-extensions-crtools
          - lib/libRdmtsigp*
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("gds-root-extensions-base", upper_bound="x") }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - gds-base-crtools
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - gdsevent
            - Rframeio
      - if: linux
        then:
          script:
            - root -b -l -x -q -e 'gSystem->Load("libRframeio");'
            - root -b -l -x -q -e 'gSystem->Load("libRgdsevent");'

  - package:
      name: gds-root-extensions-crtools
    inherit: gds-root-extensions-build
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - lib/libRdmtsigp*
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("gds-root-extensions-crtools", upper_bound="x") }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - Rdmtsigp
      - if: linux
        then:
          script:
            - root -b -x -q -e 'gSystem->Load("libRdmtsigp")'

about:
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: GDS ROOT extensions
  description: GDS ROOT extensions
  homepage: https://wiki.ligo.org/Computing/DASWG/DMT
  repository: https://git.ligo.org/gds/gds.git

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - duncanmmacleod
    - emaros
